entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's our first time at school in a while.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *yawn* I'm so sleepy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You over your jet lag?
I am.
Not yet.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real? That was quick...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah! Never mind that.[n]Did you know about this?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are popular now![n]I was surprised when we got back to Japan.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: People're actually payin' attention to[n]who we're gonna target next. Ain't that[n]amazin'?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm gettin' really psyched. This is where[n]we work hard!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's do something big again and[n]surprise the world!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still sluggish, huh? Well, same here,[n]dude...

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Good morning [lName]-senpai,[n]and... Sakamoto-senpai, correct?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, mornin'. You're back today too,[n]huh?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes! It's good to see you both.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Um, may I join you two on the way[n]to school?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I want to talk a bit more about the trip—[n]and I want to hear all of your stories from[n]Hawaii!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got it! Should I start with all the[n]heroic stuff me and this dude did for[n]the people in Hawaii?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ummm... Yes, that sounds great!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ah, good morning.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *sigh* Another day of tests...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We finally defeated Shido, but we still[n]have finals... Aren't these battles one after[n]the other tough?
They're easy.
They're tougher than Shido.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's our leader, completing exams[n]and changing hearts with ease, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, exams are nothing compared to[n]Shido!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but we only have two more days left,[n]including today! Hang in there, me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wha— How behind are you!? Handle[n]your exams like you do your changes[n]of heart...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shido was way worse than this!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Tomorrow's the final day of exams...[n]Well, let's do our best, I guess.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, Takamaki-senpai![n]And [lName]-senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What a coincidence! Good morning.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Morning! I just ran into [fName] too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How are exams treating you,[n]Yoshizawa-san? You seem awfully[n]busy with practice lately.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, it's going wonderfully! ...Practice,[n]that is. Not as much the exam part.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...I passed out while studying last night.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Heh, me too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Let's see if we can do better than that[n]today.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yes, I should see how much I can cram[n]last-minute on the commute...
